name: @casomoltd/paye-calc
description: UK PAYE take-home pay calculator — income tax, NI, pensions, student loans

scripts.//build: Cleans first: tsc leaves the compiled output of a deleted source in dist, and `files: ["dist"]` then publishes it — a withdrawn circular's transcription shipped that way from nhs-pay. prepack binds the clean build to packing, so a hand-run `npm pack` cannot ship a stale dist either.
scripts.check: check-gates && npm run check:private-refs && npm run check:personal-data && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run knip && npm run jscpd && npm run test && npm run lint:md && npm run build

gates.spell: no shared cspell config exists yet

author: Casomo Ltd
//overrides: esbuild pinned to a patched version to clear a dev-only advisory (esbuild dev-server file-read) that `npm audit fix` can not reach, transitive under vite/vitest. minimatch pinned to ^9.0.7 under remark-lint-frontmatter-schema, past its ReDoS advisories, and never at the top level: minimatch 11 breaks the ESLint import and jsx-a11y plugins. Remaining minimatch advisories are dev-only and accepted. No production impact; drop each pin when its dependant ships the fix.
